sources.title: andyx10/simplestories-trigger-organisms · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Toy model organisms with hidden conditional behaviours ("backdoors") trained into the SimpleStories models. Most are LoRAs, plus some full fine-tunes. Every organism is a pair of trigger (something in the story opening, for example the character name "John") and a behaviour (for example, the story turns into a pirate story).
